title.zh: 前沿三：四阶矩、3/4 幂 saving 与反尖峰平滑传递猜想
title.en: Frontier 3: Fourth-moment, 3/4 power-saving, and anti-spike transfer conjectures

description.zh: 结合无条件 X^(8/3+η) 二阶矩，提出四阶矩、3/4 逐点幂节省以及局部加权反尖峰传递三条独立攻关路径，绕开逐点绝对值与双线性分解，直接以均值能量消灭孤立坏偶数。
description.en: Pair the unconditional X^(8/3+η) second moment with fourth-moment, 3/4-saving, and anti-spike local averaging conjectures to rule out isolated worst-case even spikes.
